name: Noren Foundation Agent
description: The Noren Foundation's production agent, running on norend, the open-source agent operating system for accountable autonomy. Every action it takes passes a scoped capability check, debits an enforced budget, and is recorded in an append-only, hash-chained audit log. Anchoring signed audit-root attestations on Robinhood Chain is coming soon; nothing is anchored yet. Identity, permissions, and a tamper-evident audit trail: trust you can check, not claim.
